SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.title, n.content, n.cover_url, cover.width AS cover_width, cover.height AS cover_height, n.media_count, n.place_name, n.created_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, AS relevance_score FROM notes n INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = n.user_id AND u.status = 1 LEFT JOIN media cover ON cover.note_id = n.id AND cover.order_no = 1 WHERE n.visibility = 1
/* P18 屏蔽双向过滤 */ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_blocks b WHERE (b.user_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocked_user_id = n.user_id) OR (b.user_id = n.user_id AND b.blocked_user_id = #{viewerId}))
AND
AND ( < #{cursorScore} OR ( = #{cursorScore} AND (n.created_at < #{cursorCreatedAt} OR (n.created_at = #{cursorCreatedAt} AND n.id < #{cursorId}))) )
AND (n.created_at < #{cursorCreatedAt} OR (n.created_at = #{cursorCreatedAt} AND n.id < #{cursorId}))
ORDER BY relevance_score DESC, n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
